_reference_pool_doc: Since 2026-10-18 (user decision, E-013) new candidates play only these (no all-vs-all); greedy_v2 is the incumbent. choke and exploit_v2 added the same day (user decision, E-017). See docs/evaluation.md section 5.
_heldout_pool_doc: Written 2026-10-18 by a separate agent that was told not to read our code, docs or results (E-015). Never use them for screening, tuning or debugging; never read their code or replays while designing candidates. Use only for the release gate and rare logged checkpoints. See docs/evaluation.md section 5.
_doc: Opponent pool / league (docs/evaluation.md). 'ours': rules-checked by eval/check_rules.py. Entries whose file is marked frozen must never change; new versions get new files.

submission.notes: whatever is currently in my_team.py (the tournament entry; = greedy_v2 since 2026-10-18, E-013); use for release gates, not as a frozen league member

baseline.notes: framework baseline: reflex attacker that only returns at <=2 food, reflex defender

camper.notes: specialist (P-02): greedy attacker + a defender that camps where the enemy would cross

camper2.notes: specialist: two border campers, never attacks (a stronger turtle)

baseline_plus.notes: specialist (P-01): baseline-style reflex team with return-at-5 and ghost avoidance

lab_off.notes: greedy_lab_v1 with every switch off: must play exactly like greedy (identity check only)

lab_tracker.notes: C3 possible-position tracking in the attacker's race-safety (H-S01 set version)

feature.notes: F1 weighted-feature attacker (M-02, hand-set weights) + greedy's PatrolDefender

field.notes: F2 potential-field attacker (hand-set weights) + greedy's PatrolDefender

rusher_camper.notes: candidate from E-006: capsule-first attacker + border camper (both beat greedy head-to-head)

lab_breaker_tracker.notes: C2 + C3 together (they looked complementary on the E-005 tie maps)

lab_breaker_ret8_intercept.notes: C2 + C4 + return at 8 (combination of the three best E-010 changes; not screened)

greedy_v2.notes: greedy_lab_v1 with breaker + intercept + return_at 8 as defaults (E-011/E-012); INCUMBENT, promoted to my_team.py 2026-10-18 (E-013)

choke.notes: P-18 specialist (H-M03): greedy_v2's attacker + a defender that guards the cell sealing off the most food and traps invaders behind cut cells (E-015)

exploit_v2.notes: P-18 exploiter written against greedy_v2's E-014 weaknesses: F1 attacker (rarely dies) + a defender that shadows the raider at the border and traps it behind cut cells (E-015)

lab2_off.notes: greedy_lab_v2 with every new switch off: must play exactly like greedy_v2 (identity check only, E-018)

lab2_exit.notes: P-19 exit-race check for the attacker (H-M02 + H-S03, generalised to cut cells)

lab2_squeeze.notes: P-20 defender: trap behind cut cells, close in, chase after a stalled intercept

lab2_raid.notes: P-21 raiding defender while our attacker is held at the border (no shared memory)

heldout_a.notes: HELD-OUT (E-015): written blind by a separate agent. Style label only: aggressive double attack with capsule use, defends only when it detects an invader

heldout_b.notes: HELD-OUT (E-015): written blind by a separate agent. Style label only: defence first, one permanent guard + a cautious raider, turtles when ahead late
